dataset: beachlitter: NCEI Nurdle Patrol + beach sand, EMODnet beach litter (CB), NOAA MDMAP
qc_policy: qc bits 0-3 = protocol (1 EMODnet, OSPAR 100 m list; 2 EMODnet, OSPAR 1 km list (items > 50 cm); 3 EMODnet, MSFD TSG-ML master list; 4 EMODnet, Joint List (J codes); 5 EMODnet, Joint List and TSG-ML in one survey; 6 EMODnet, UNEP/IOC list (incl. MARLIN); 7 EMODnet, Italian national list; 8 MDMAP 2.0; 9 MDMAP standing stock; 10 MDMAP accumulation; 11 Nurdle Patrol (pellets picked by hand); 12 NCEI beach-sand microplastics sample); bit 4 (16): time of day not given, placed at 12:00 UTC (every row); bit 5 (32): freshwater shore (farther than 10 km from the sea coast and nearer a Natural Earth lake or river); bit 6 (64): litter protocols — survey length not given, the protocol's default assumed; Nurdle Patrol — NCEI's published standardised rate is neither floor nor ceil of the recomputed one; bit 7 (128): position doubt (farther than 25 km from every mapped shore, fewer than 3 published decimals, EMODnet start > 5 km from the location or a two-coordinate location code, MDMAP ends > 5 km apart). Values outside the bounds -> NaN, counted. A row with no density is dropped.
title: Litter on beaches and shorelines: one row per survey (NOAA NCEI Nurdle Patrol pellet counts and beach-sand microplastics, EMODnet beach litter under CC BY, NOAA MDMAP)
verified: 2026-10-13 from the sandbox: the NCEI Hub CSV (29,076 rows; 10,615 Nurdle Patrol, 893 Beach), accession 0259486 v2.2's workbook and data dictionary, the EMODnet beach-litter v2025 European zip (16,861 surveys, 2,084,972 lines; data policy CB 4,444, LS 8,130, UN 4,287), the MDMAP portal's site list (1,271 sites) and every site's export, and Natural Earth v5.1.2's coastline, minor-island coastline, lakes and river centre-lines
